authority: Applicable ISO requirements and explicit shared ISOBASE decisions; neither implementation is an oracle
iso_clause_audit: pending; no claim of complete standards compliance

open_decisions.D02: Numeric range, rationals and non-finite values
open_decisions.D03: Strings, Unicode lexical forms and NUL
open_decisions.D05: URI forms, RPC options and asynchronous outcomes
open_decisions.D06: Wire errors, continuation identity and replay

decided_scope: C04 dispositions in boundary-decisions.json; implementation completion remains K02/K03/K05/K06.

portable_domain.integers: Minimum shared exact range, not a ban on larger host integers. Programs exchanging results outside it need an explicitly agreed extension.
portable_domain.double_quotes: codes; decoded Unicode scalar values. ASCII migration tested here; full source Unicode remains K03.
portable_domain.characters: Unicode scalar atom/code interface excluding U+0000 in the portable wire domain; additional host characters are optional.
portable_domain.number_conversion: Separate character and code list types. Portable syntax excludes rationals, NaN/infinity spellings and non-ASCII decimal digits.
portable_domain.rpc_addresses: Explicit HTTP(S) atom or Host:Port. Preserve base path prefix; append /call; no base query, fragment or userinfo. No implicit local/self aliases. Exact src_uri URLs are a separate interface.
portable_domain.rpc_options: Closed public vocabulary; no arbitrary HTTP/TLS hooks. Reject negative or >300s caller deadlines before I/O for the portable baseline.

decision_status.D02: 42-case range/float/lexical policy decided; complete arithmetic/representation audit still required
decision_status.D03: codes double quotes and portable character domain selected; remaining lexical audit open
decision_status.D05: address/options subset decided; remaining asynchronous modes and formal-error taxonomy open
